01

Who we are

Orvix operates orvixnet.com. For any question about your information, or to use the rights below, write to info@orvixnet.com.

02

Analytics, only if you agree

With your consent, we use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used: which pages are visited, roughly where visitors come from, and which device and browser they use. It sets cookies and sends this information to Google.

It runs only after you click Accept on the cookie banner. If you decline, or have not chosen yet, no analytics script is loaded and nothing is sent. Withdrawing your consent also removes the analytics cookies from your browser.

Your cookie choiceChange it whenever you like. Your choice is stored only in this browser.
03

Who processes your information

ServiceWhat forInformationKept
Google AnalyticsUnderstanding how the site is used (only with consent)Pages visited, approximate location, device and browserRetention period set in our account
BrevoSending the Perspectives newsletterEmail address, language, sector if givenUntil you unsubscribe
CalendlyBooking a call with our teamThe details you enter when bookingAs long as needed to follow up
NetlifyHosting and protecting the siteIP address and request details in server logsPer Netlify's log retention
04

Newsletter

If you subscribe to Perspectives, we store your email address, your preferred language and, if you give it, your sector, with Brevo, our email provider. We use them only to send the newsletter. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe, after which we stop sending.

05

Booking a call

The booking calendar on our Contact page is provided by Calendly. The details you enter there go to Calendly and to us, so that we can hold the call. Calendly's own privacy policy applies to its service.

06

Hosting and security

The site is hosted by Netlify, which processes technical information such as IP addresses in its server logs to deliver the site and protect it from abuse. Our forms limit how often they can be used, for the same reason.

07

Staff sign-in

The blog administration area is for Orvix staff only. Signing in sets two strictly necessary cookies, one for the sign-in link and one for the session. They are used for nothing else.

08

Your rights

Get a copy

Ask what information we hold about you.

Correct or delete

Have inaccurate information fixed, or removed.

Withdraw consent

Turn off analytics or unsubscribe, at any time.

09

Changes to this notice

If this notice changes, we update the date at the top of this page.

Questions about your information?

Write to us and a member of the team will reply.
